name: io.github.miningstore/average-rent
title: Average Rent
description: Compare US apartment asking rents, market trends, and price cuts. Sign in with Average Rent.

tools.name: list_covered_cities
tools.description: Find tracked city slugs, sample counts, observation dates, and source links. Filter by city name or slug, or request a page of up to 100 cities. An empty request returns the full catalog.

query.description: Case-insensitive city name or slug text, for example Austin or austin-tx.

limit.description: Maximum cities per page. Defaults to 100 when a filter or offset is supplied.

offset.description: Number of matching cities to skip. Defaults to 0.

tools.name: get_market_stats
tools.description: Read asking rent statistics and bedroom breakdowns for a tracked city.

city.description: City slug returned by list_covered_cities, for example austin-tx. Resolve city names with list_covered_cities.

tools.name: get_national_summary
tools.description: Read the tracked national rent sample. Optionally compare one state with the national sample.

state.description: Two-letter US state code, for example TX. Omit to read the national sample without a state comparison.

tools.name: search_apartments
tools.description: Find last-verified apartment listings. Supply a city, state, ZIP, or property name. A neighborhood requires its city. min_rent must not exceed max_rent. Multiple building names may match; use returned IDs. Results include asking rents, verification dates, and source links.

city.description: City slug returned by list_covered_cities, for example austin-tx. Resolve city names with list_covered_cities.

state.description: Two-letter US state code, for example TX. Restrict matches to that state.

zip.description: Five-digit US ZIP code, for example 78704. Keep any leading zero.

neighborhood.description: Neighborhood name to match within the supplied city. Supply city with this filter.

query.description: Property name or street address text to match. Use 1 to 120 characters. Multiple buildings may match.

bedrooms.description: Exact bedroom count from 0 to 5. Use 0 for a studio. Omit to include all bedroom counts.

min_rent.description: Minimum monthly asking rent in whole US dollars, inclusive. Must not exceed max_rent.

max_rent.description: Maximum monthly asking rent in whole US dollars, inclusive. Must be at least min_rent.

limit.description: Maximum apartment results to return, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 25.

offset.description: Number of matching apartment results to skip, from 0 to 10000. Defaults to 0. Use to request later pages.

tools.name: get_property
tools.description: Read one building and its last-known unit prices, fees, concessions, and verification date. Respect no_current_availability.

property_id.description: Property ID from search_apartments results. Use this positive integer to select one building.

tools.name: get_rent_history
tools.description: Read daily asking rent history for either a city or a property. Supply exactly one of city or property_id. Changes in the tracked sample can affect market trends.

city.description: City slug returned by list_covered_cities, for example austin-tx. Resolve city names with list_covered_cities.

property_id.description: Property ID from search_apartments results. Use this positive integer to select one building.

days.description: Number of past days to read, from 7 to 365. Defaults to 90 for a city and 180 for a property.

tools.name: get_price_cuts
tools.description: Read observed asking rent reductions over the last seven days in one tracked city. These observations do not guarantee current availability.

city.description: City slug returned by list_covered_cities, for example austin-tx. Resolve city names with list_covered_cities.

limit.description: Maximum price reductions to return, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 25. Results start with the largest dollar cuts.

tools.name: get_account_usage
tools.description: Read your account plan, data-use license, shared data call allowance, usage, and UTC reset date. Check commercial_use_allowed when the user states a commercial purpose. This tool does not consume the data allowance.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Return the stable identity of this authenticated Average Rent account.

tools.name: report_feedback
tools.description: Create a GitHub issue for an Average Rent bug, feature request, or other feedback the user asks to submit. Send only the title and description they approve. Do not include private account data or conversation history. Returns the issue link. Requires feedback:write and uses no rent-data calls.

title.description: Short issue title approved by the user, from 1 to 160 characters on one line.

description.description: Feedback text approved by the user, up to 8000 characters. Include the problem, expected result, and steps when known. Exclude private data.

category.description: Feedback type: bug, feature, or other. Defaults to other.
